properties.name: veto.security.deployer-policy
properties.description: Active install-time path and tenant policy. PROTECTED, SANDBOXED, and TENANT use their matching veto.security section; FULL_ACCESS needs no additional settings.

properties.name: veto.security.screening-mode
properties.description: Per-session auto-approval matrix. DANGEROUS always requires authorization and CRITICAL is always refused.

properties.name: veto.terminal.enabled
properties.description: Whether the local terminal IPC server is enabled.

properties.name: veto.terminal.bind-address
properties.description: ZeroMQ bind address for the local terminal IPC server.

properties.name: veto.http.timeout-seconds
properties.description: Timeout for an authorized HTTP read, in seconds.

properties.name: veto.http.max-chars
properties.description: Maximum characters returned by an authorized HTTP read.

properties.name: veto.http.allow-private-addresses
properties.description: Allow authorized HTTP reads to contact loopback, link-local, private, or multicast destinations. Keep disabled unless agents must access a trusted intranet.

values.description: Host paths are unrestricted; Gateway screening and HITL remain active.
Host paths are reachable except for the policy's hard protected-path deny-list.
Session roots must be admitted within deployer-configured project zones and form a hard execution boundary.
Per-owner session roots are admitted within tenant zones with cross-user isolation.
SAFE/ELEVATED calls auto-approve; DANGEROUS still requires authorization.
